name: Worth
overview: Scripture reveals our worth as rooted in being created in God's image, granting humanity a unique dignity and authority over creation (Genesis 1:26). God's immense love is demonstrated through the giving of His only Son so that believers might have eternal life, affirming our value despite our sinful state (John 3:16; Romans 5:8). This divine love assures us of God's constant presence and provision, encouraging contentment and trust in His unfailing care (Hebrews 13:5). Thus, our worth is defined both by God's intentional design and His sacrificial love.
